hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */awg-server|*/dist/*) echo "BLOCKED: build artifact ($f)" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f"; (cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && go vet ./... 2>&1 | head -20) ;; esac
